answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The lotus multiplier is published, charged in dune, and velvet lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1254 identities would post 1632 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
